The `go` procedure is responsible for advancing the model's state at each tick.

The code below show the `go` procedure of the `Logônia` model. `LogoClim` insertions are denoted with `; LogoClim` at the end of the line to make it easier to identify which parts of the code are specific to `LogoClim` and which are related to `Logônia`.

```netlogo
to go
  if ((month = "December") and (year = 2024)) [ ; LogoClim
    stop
  ]

  ls:ask ls:models [go] ; LogoClim

  set index [index] ls:of tmin-ls-model ; LogoClim
  set month [month] ls:of tmin-ls-model ; LogoClim
  set year [year] ls:of tmin-ls-model ; LogoClim

  update-climate-variables ; LogoClim

  ; ...
```
